content:
library(shiny) library(shinyWidgets) library(leaflet) library(tidyverse) # Load pre-processed GeoJSON, centroids, and panel data (zero sf dependency!) panel_map_data <- readRDS("panel_data.rds") peru_centroids <- readRDS("peru_centroids.rds") peru_geojson <- readRDS("peru_geojson.rds") election_years <- as.character(sort(unique(as.numeric(as.character(panel_map_data$Year))))) enp_pal <- colorNumeric( palette = c("#ffffff", "#fcbba1", "#fb6a4a", "#cb181d", "#67000d"), domain = c(2, 13), na.color = "#d9d9d9" ) ui <- fluidPage( tags$head(tags$style(".leaflet-container { background: #f8f9fa; }")), titlePanel("Peruvian Departmental Electoral Fragmentation (ENP), 1980–2026"), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel( width = 3, sliderTextInput( inputId = "selected_year", label = "Select Election Year:", choices = election_years, selected = election_years[1], grid = TRUE, animate = animationOptions(interval = 1200, loop = FALSE) ), hr(), selectInput( inputId = "label_var", label = "Map Text Labels:", choices = c( "None" = "none", "Department Name" = "dept_clean", "Effective Number of Parties Value" = "enp_text", "Colloquial Region" = "Colloquial_Region", "Cardinal Region" = "Cardinal_Region", "Indigenous Voter Cleavage" = "IVP" ), selected = "none" ), helpText("Hover over any department for exact ENP and regional metadata.") ), mainPanel( width = 9, leafletOutput("peru_enp_map", height = "750px") ) ) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { yearly_data <- reactive({ df_year <- panel_map_data |> filter(as.character(Year) == as.character(input$selected_year)) peru_centroids |> left_join(df_year, by = "dept_clean") |> mutate( enp_text = ifelse(is.na(ENP), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", ENP)), fill_col = enp_pal(ENP), hover_popup = paste0( "", dept_clean, " (", input$selected_year, ")
", "ENP: ", enp_text, "
", "Colloquial Region: ", Colloquial_Region, "
", "Cardinal Region: ", Cardinal_Region, "
", "IVP: ", IVP ) ) }) output$peru_enp_map <- renderLeaflet({ leaflet() |> setView(lng = -75.0, lat = -9.2, zoom = 5) |> addLegend( pal = enp_pal, values = c(2, 13), title = "Effective Number
of Parties (ENP)", position = "bottomright" ) }) observe({ df <- yearly_data() # Inject per-department fill colors and hover popups directly into GeoJSON features gj <- peru_geojson gj$features <- lapply(gj$features, function(feat) { dname <- feat$properties$dept_clean row <- df[df$dept_clean == dname, , drop = FALSE] fill_hex <- if (nrow(row) > 0 && !is.na(row$fill_col[1])) row$fill_col[1] else "#d9d9d9" feat$properties$style <- list( fillColor = fill_hex, fillOpacity = 0.85, color = "#444444", weight = 1.2 ) feat }) proxy <- leafletProxy("peru_enp_map") |> clearGeoJSON() |> clearMarkers() |> addGeoJSON(gj) |> # Invisible circle markers at centroids provide rich HTML hover tooltips addCircleMarkers( data = df, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, radius = 14, stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0, label = ~lapply(hover_popup, htmltools::HTML) ) if (input$label_var != "none") { proxy |> addLabelOnlyMarkers( data = df, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, label = ~as.character(.data[[input$label_var]]), labelOptions = labelOptions( noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", textOnly = TRUE, style = list( "font-weight" = "bold", "font-size" = "10px", "color" = "#111111", "text-shadow" = "1px 1px 2px #ffffff" ) ) ) } }) } shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
